lenses.name: Population
lenses.description: Residents per km² of land. Each county's population (ACS B01003) is spread over its hexes in proportion to how much of the county each hex covers. Colours span the 2nd–98th percentile of hexes; values beyond are drawn at the end colours.

lenses.name: Income
lenses.description: Median household income of the counties in each hex, weighted by population (ACS B19013, inflation-adjusted to the last survey year). Colours span the 2nd–98th percentile of hexes; values beyond are drawn at the end colours.

lenses.name: Home value
lenses.description: Median value of owner-occupied homes, weighted by population (ACS B25077). Colours span the 2nd–98th percentile of hexes; values beyond are drawn at the end colours.

lenses.name: Poverty
lenses.unit: share of people below the poverty line
lenses.description: Share of people whose family income in the past 12 months was below the official poverty threshold (ACS B17001 line 2 ÷ line 1; universe: people for whom poverty status is determined, which excludes e.g. people in dorms and institutions). Colours span the 2nd–98th percentile of hexes; values beyond are drawn at the end colours.

lenses.name: Median age
lenses.description: Median age of residents (ACS B01002). A hex mixing several counties shows the population-weighted mean of their medians, an approximation of the true median. Colours span the 2nd–98th percentile of hexes; values beyond are drawn at the end colours.

lenses.name: Born abroad
lenses.unit: share of residents born outside the U.S.
lenses.description: Share of residents who are foreign-born (ACS B05012 line 3 ÷ line 1). Colours span the 2nd–98th percentile of hexes; values beyond are drawn at the end colours.

lenses.name: Degrees
lenses.unit: adults 25+ with a bachelor's degree or higher
lenses.description: Share of adults aged 25 and over whose highest degree is a bachelor's, master's, professional or doctorate (ACS B15003 lines 22–25 ÷ line 1). Colours span the 2nd–98th percentile of hexes; values beyond are drawn at the end colours.

lenses.name: Broadband
lenses.description: Share of households with a broadband internet subscription of any type, including cellular data plans (ACS B28002 line 4 ÷ line 1). Colours span the 2nd–98th percentile of hexes; values beyond are drawn at the end colours.

lenses.name: Commute
lenses.unit: mean minutes to work, one way
lenses.description: Mean one-way travel time to work of workers 16+ who do not work from home (ACS B08013 aggregate minutes ÷ B08303 workers). Colours span the 2nd–98th percentile of hexes; values beyond are drawn at the end colours.

lenses.name: Homeowners
lenses.unit: occupied homes lived in by their owner
lenses.description: Homeownership rate: owner-occupied ÷ all occupied housing units (ACS B25003). Colours span the 2nd–98th percentile of hexes; values beyond are drawn at the end colours.

lenses.name: Uninsured
lenses.unit: share of people without health insurance
lenses.description: Share of the civilian noninstitutionalized population with no health insurance coverage (ACS B27010, the four 'no coverage' lines across age groups ÷ line 1). Colours span the 2nd–98th percentile of hexes; values beyond are drawn at the end colours.

lenses.name: Forest
lenses.description: Share of the hex's land covered by deciduous, evergreen or mixed forest (NLCD). Colours span the 2nd–98th percentile of hexes; values beyond are drawn at the end colours.

lenses.name: Farmland
lenses.description: Share of the hex's land in cultivated crops or pasture/hay (NLCD 81 + 82). Colours span the 2nd–98th percentile of hexes; values beyond are drawn at the end colours.

lenses.name: Built-up
lenses.description: Share of the hex's land that is developed at low, medium or high intensity (NLCD 22–24; parks and lawns, NLCD 21, are not counted). Colours span the 2nd–98th percentile of hexes; values beyond are drawn at the end colours.

lenses.name: Faith
lenses.note: Counts adherents of congregations where they worship, not residents' beliefs. About half of Americans are counted, and some traditions (notably historically Black churches) are under-reported. 2020 data. Connecticut not shown.
lenses.description: Religious adherents per 100 residents in 2020: adherents reported by the congregations in each county (members, their children and regular attenders, counted where the congregation meets) ÷ the 2020 population × 100, population-weighted over a hex's counties. Computed from the counts, not the file's rate columns. A county with a large church drawing from its neighbours can exceed 100; the colours stop at 100. Source: 2020 U.S. Religion Census (ASARB), via the Association of Religion Data Archives (theARDA.com). Connecticut is blank because the census uses its 8 old counties.

lenses.name: Largest tradition
lenses.note: Counts adherents of congregations where they worship, not residents' beliefs. About half of Americans are counted, and some traditions (notably historically Black churches) are under-reported. 2020 data. Connecticut not shown.

categories.name: Evangelical Protestant
categories.description: ARDA's Evangelical Protestant tradition (e.g. Southern Baptists, non-denominational churches, Assemblies of God).

categories.name: Mainline Protestant
categories.description: ARDA's Mainline Protestant tradition (e.g. United Methodist, ELCA Lutheran, Presbyterian USA, Episcopal).

categories.name: Black Protestant
categories.description: ARDA's Black Protestant tradition (historically Black denominations; under-reported in 2020).

categories.name: Latter-day Saints
categories.description: The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints (split out of ARDA's 'Other').

categories.name: Other faiths
categories.description: ARDA's 'Other' tradition without the Latter-day Saints: Jewish, Muslim, Buddhist, Hindu and other groups.

lenses.description: The religious tradition with the most adherents in 2020 (ARDA's six traditions, with Latter-day Saints split out of 'Other'), summing each tradition's adherents over the counties in the hex in proportion to how much of each county the hex covers. 'Largest' can mean a plurality of a small share of residents. Source: 2020 U.S. Religion Census (ASARB) via ARDA. Connecticut is blank.

lenses.name: Wellbeing
lenses.note: Model-based CDC estimates of adult health, not a happiness survey. No data for Kentucky or Pennsylvania (2025 release).
lenses.description: A health and wellbeing index (standing in for the strategy-game Amenities) from CDC PLACES 2025 age-adjusted estimates for adults: 100 − 10 × the mean z-score of four shares — frequent mental distress (mhlth), depression, fair or poor self-rated health (ghlth) and no leisure-time physical activity (lpa). Each z-score compares the county with the mean ± standard deviation of all mapped counties (mhlth 18.6% ± 2.0; depression 24.1% ± 3.4; ghlth 20.7% ± 4.6; lpa 27.1% ± 5.4). 110 means one standard deviation better than average on all four. Population-weighted over a hex's counties. Null where PLACES has no data (all of Kentucky and Pennsylvania in this release): never imputed. Colours span the 2nd–98th percentile of hexes; values beyond are drawn at the end colours.

lenses.name: Disasters
lenses.note: A declaration is an administrative act that unlocks federal aid, not a measure of damage.
lenses.description: Distinct FEMA major-disaster (DR) declarations naming the county from 2000-01-01 to 2026-11-25, each disaster counted once (Biological/COVID-19, emergency and fire-management declarations excluded; statewide declarations are not counted for counties). A hex shows the population-weighted mean of its counties, rounded to a whole number. Connecticut's planning regions count a disaster declared for any old county they overlap. Colours span the 2nd–98th percentile of hexes; values beyond are drawn at the end colours.

lenses.name: Veterans
lenses.unit: share of civilian adults who are veterans
lenses.description: Share of the civilian population aged 18 and over who are veterans (ACS B21001 line 2 ÷ line 1), population-weighted over a hex's counties. Active-duty service members are not civilians and are not in this count. Colours span the 2nd–98th percentile of hexes; values beyond are drawn at the end colours.
